features.title: 安装、官方版共存、APK 备份恢复与资源部署
features.entry: Outer installer MainActivity and explicit install/restore controls
features.defaults: Device/profile-dependent install workflow; main APK identity/signature is fixed
features.implementation: Outer LocalAdb implements normal RSA ADB authentication at controller loopback. RC2 bootstrap checks uid first, then conditionally sets the boot debug property and ADB TCP/restart properties and polls for root uid. It bundles the already-known A-031 Fuli utility, a secondary installer, Files helper and UI/media resources. It checks original/main APK hashes, offers original package removal keeping data, installs the supplied signed main package and seeds coexist/launcher resources.
features.write_or_side_effect: Android package/property/file changes and force-stop operations if the host permits them; no novel privilege-grant exploit established
features.confirmation: Package identity/hash and selected shell results; no actual install, successful root grant or device persistence observed in this review
features.restore_lifecycle: Original APK restore is not a full backup of app data, permissions, ADB/system settings or helper packages. RC Pro profile is specifically the inspected enterprise/rm510/SDK29 branch, not every RC Pro.
features.reuse: Borrow explicit artifact identity and backup verification. Build our own narrow installer/rollback model; do not assume stock installer accepts a modified/re-signed main APK.

features.title: RID Kill：云控拦截及 legacy DroneID / EID 周期请求
features.entry: S.ridKill/settings callback; UAVRidCloudControlLogic and BroadcastEffectCloudControlLogic connection/write hooks -> Rid.onConnect
features.defaults: rid_kill defaults true, including preference access failure
features.implementation: Guards suppress selected RID cloud subscription/write paths. A connected worker sends legacy DataFlycDetection SetSwitch with eight false entries twice, 250 ms apart, and requests EIDSwitch=false through the SDK, then schedules another cycle after 12 s. The first cycle issues before/after mask GETs but only logs them. Exact native EID owner remains the France EID command plane.
features.write_or_side_effect: Actual device SET candidates plus application cloud-path changes; this does not implement a standard BLE/Wi-Fi RID master switch
features.confirmation: Waits for callbacks but does not parse/enforce/save initial mask state; no EID independent GET. ACK is not device-applied/RF evidence.
features.restore_lifecycle: Disabling/disconnect removes queued cycles; it does not restore original mask/EID state, prove in-flight quiescence, or reconstruct every skipped subscription. The first-cycle marker is not reset on reconnect in the inspected class.
features.reuse: Use as owner/call-path evidence and a demonstration of in-process hooks. Do not reuse its default-on loop, blanket disable or restore semantics for FindUAS.

features.title: 遥控器 Android 定位开关
features.defaults: Manual control; saves Android restore_mode before changing location_mode
features.implementation: Changes Settings.Secure location_mode through the host ContentResolver and checks Android provider/settings state. This controls the controller's location service, separately from aircraft FCGPSEnabled.
features.write_or_side_effect: Host Android location configuration
features.confirmation: Provider/readback polling up to 5 s with a settings fallback; no airplane GNSS, RID or radio proof
features.restore_lifecycle: Stores a local prior mode for restoration; success depends on Android permissions and platform behavior
features.reuse: A separately labelled host-location control is useful. Do not conflate it with aircraft positioning or a RID location source.

features.title: 飞机 GPS 开关与 RC2 兼容桥
features.defaults: Manual action; quick state may be cached
features.implementation: FCGPSEnabled SDK route is separate from host Android GPS. On non-rc331, NativeKeys.write waits for SET and performs up to three GET checks. The rc331 path also sends repeated parameter writes through a controller-local bridge and updates gpsLast before receiving any device confirmation.
features.write_or_side_effect: Aircraft GPS state change candidate; rc331 compatibility bridge is a separate transport path
features.confirmation: RC2 bridge sends do not await a matching ACK and exceptions can be swallowed; true/OK UI return does not prove the aircraft accepted the change
features.restore_lifecycle: No verified original-state journal or complete restore/RF chain; reconnect/reboot behavior untested
features.reuse: Borrow SDK owner discovery and readback pattern. Rebuild one measured transport path with exact session binding; reject the unacknowledged bridge as a verified control.

features.title: 飞行记录 UIMap / 轨迹 JSON 导出
features.defaults: Manual; existing output filenames are skipped
features.implementation: Reads Fly FlightRecord/MCDatFlightRecords candidates and invokes UavJNIFlightRecordUIMapConvertor nativeInit/parseWithFilePath then parserFrUIMapData. JSON/Base64 MapDetailData is decoded to a .decrypted.json trajectory/map representation with aircraft/home/user positions.
features.write_or_side_effect: Reads local log files and writes local JSON; no aircraft state change
features.confirmation: Native parser result codes 0/200/205 enter conversion. No real encrypted log was processed in this review; the prior schema check used synthetic data only.
features.restore_lifecycle: Output-exists skip can retain an older result. DAT suffix scanning is not proof DAT support; the module's help says DAT is unsupported.
features.reuse: Useful for map/trajectory extraction in the fixed host after validating real input. It is not a complete raw flight-record decoder or TBIE/STUE firmware decryptor.

features.title: FC 参数扫描、修改、DHP 备份和选择性恢复
features.defaults: Explicit scan/edit/export/import; KnownGroups names classify returned parameters only
features.implementation: Discovers table metadata through E0/E1, reads values with E2, writes E3 through an independent DataBase subclass and the existing ServiceManager transport. verifiedWrite checks fresh metadata and expected-before value, writes, then independently E2-reads and compares. DHP export snapshots memory; restore matches by name with type/range/ambiguity checks and previews selected items.
features.write_or_side_effect: Actual aircraft parameter SET candidates when connection/flight/motor gates pass; copied metadata attribute=1 is not recovered write permission
features.confirmation: Per-write separate readback is present. Actual Mini 5 Pro support and each parameter effect are unobserved. Completeness flags cover discovered/accepted rows only.
features.restore_lifecycle: Export can combine old values with newly-read identity. Restore is not bound to the backup's original device; successful early writes persist if a later item fails. Cancel is not transport quiescence. No durable baseline/rollback for a write whose ACK succeeds but readback fails.
features.reuse: Highest-value control pattern: metadata discovery, expected-before check and independent readback. Reimplement the transport adapter, epoch/identity fences, original-state journal and partial-result handling in our own code.

features.title: 继承的 DJI Fly 主体与进程内 SDK 环境
features.entry: Manifest DJIApplication -> UAVApplication / UAVSDKManager; existing Fly activities/services
features.defaults: Normal Fly application lifecycle, plus the separately inventoried mod providers/hooks
features.implementation: The supplied APK retains Fly's existing aircraft connection, FPV/camera/media, flight-record/map, device-settings and mission-related code. Mod features reuse those views, model streams, DataBase ownership and native SDK rather than operating as a separate generic remote controller.
features.write_or_side_effect: Inherited host capabilities remain subject to original model/service/permission conditions; this row is a dependency summary, not certification of every official feature
features.confirmation: Package/class/manifest and selected call-chain evidence only. The review does not reimplement or exhaustively audit every inherited Fly algorithm or third-party library.
features.restore_lifecycle: Same-process initialized SDK, native libraries and current aircraft link are required. Copying wrapper classes into another Android process does not reproduce this state.
features.reuse: Recommended foundation is our own small source module plus a version-bound host adapter. APK patching is a fixed-base experiment; whole-app decompiled-Java rebuilding is not a maintainable source fork.
evidence: 32-DEX class inventory and manifest; UAVApplication; UAVSDKManager

features.title: 遥测目录、收藏、轮询、监听与单项读取
features.defaults: Monitor monitor_enabled=true; interval 1000 ms, clamped to 500..60000; overlays have separate settings
features.implementation: Catalog has 5200 unique Item IDs (3599 SDK and 1601 push); Monitor adds 2 local derived entries. Four workers, at most four in-flight jobs, a 50 ms scheduling clock and separate connection worker. SDK items resolve UAVKeyInfo by reflection, cache the key object, and use UAVKeyManager GET/LISTEN/cache paths. Push getters read DataBase singleton packet caches after isGetted/isPushLosed checks. Local height derives from AircraftLocation3D; network RX uses total Android TrafficStats, not video bitrate.
features.write_or_side_effect: Ordinary read paths do not implement a generic device SET. Read-all first samples caches; eligible missing SDK entries are subsequently queued for active GET/listen reads, so read-all is not wholly passive.
features.confirmation: Rc2Reader marks SDK fallback cache and push_cache as fresh=false with unknown age; GET waits up to 6 s. Catalog membership/declared type does not prove model support or correct units.
features.restore_lifecycle: Selected items and enabled favorites drive background work; listener handles are released when unused. Connection/session generations reject stale callbacks. stopScan clears queued jobs and increments scan generation but does not cancel already-dispatched transport requests or stop the separate favorite monitor.
features.reuse: High: reuse the source-kind/freshness model and small selected-key monitor, rebuilding our own adapter. Do not enumerate every catalog candidate on connection or call displayed values fresh without source evidence.
evidence: telemetry/Catalog.java:122-5624 (5200 Item constructors counted without executing vendor code)

features.title: 遥测手动推送请求
features.entry: telecustom.ValueEditor.Form Advanced Request update button -> Monitor.requestPush -> PushRequests.read; shown only for supported items, with no extra confirmation in this chain
features.defaults: Only an explicit supported-item request invokes this path; ordinary catalog browsing is distinct
features.implementation: Five supported owners: DataFlycGetPushGpsSnr, DataCameraGetPushChart, DataOsdGetPushConfig, DataSmartBatteryGetPushDynamicData and DataSmartBatteryGetPushCellVoltage. GPS SNR requests DataFlycSetPushGpsSnr.setEnable(true). Battery requests create a new model with index 0, requestPush=false and continuePush=true; those field names are not a proven wire semantic.
features.write_or_side_effect: GPS SNR starts an aircraft diagnostic push; no paired disable/restore was found in this class. Other supported models send their request via the existing DataBase transport.
features.confirmation: Waits for callbacks up to 6 s; SNR polls a packet snapshot for up to 3 s. No initial packet sequence/freshness baseline is captured, so an older packet can satisfy this check.
features.restore_lifecycle: A UI scan stop does not establish request quiescence. SNR enable is not tied to a durable original-state record or restoration on exit.
features.reuse: Use only as a list of candidate SDK owners. Reimplement an explicit action contract and fresh-result correlation before adopting active requests.

features.entry: modsettings160.TelemetrySettings.Page -> gnsslab.Page.entry; Page.Session.resume/acquirePage; manifest gnsslab.TestActivity wraps the same Page.Session and is exported with android.permission.DUMP required
features.defaults: Entering the page acquires a collector lease; page mode requests SNR enable once per aircraft generation. HTTP /start alone does not automatically enable SNR/raw.
features.implementation: Bridge listens to aircraft GPS/location/velocity/diagnostic keys and controller keys, observes Android GnssStatus and passive LocationManager updates with fine-location permission, and maintains separate aircraft/controller records. Page refreshes diagnostic states periodically. GnssModel assigns synthetic S+slot identifiers to aircraft SNR arrays (32/32/32/64 slots), separates the high-bit flag from raw&127 magnitude, and does not prove physical dB-Hz or satellite identity. Controller values come from Android C/N0 and constellation/carrier metadata.
features.write_or_side_effect: Page acquisition requests GPSSNRInfoPushEnable=true; other collected values are reads/listens. No coordinate setter is implemented here.
features.confirmation: Caches are unknown-age and not fresh; ordinary source ages use a 5 s display threshold. Listener age is time since value change, not guaranteed last packet reception. Android fix validation uses elapsed fix time; valid geographic range alone does not reject 0,0.
features.restore_lifecycle: Page leases, collection generation and aircraft generation guard work/callbacks; explicit disconnect clears aircraft records/raw data and invalidates refresh. External ownership or a manual switch request can keep collection running after page close.
features.reuse: High for a GNSS diagnostic view, with explicit active-request consent in our UI and corrected restoration. Does not establish RID position source, spoofing, or RF control.

features.title: GNSS 本地 HTTP、原始数据缓存与诊断开关
features.defaults: Starts with collector/page use; loopback only; no authentication token
features.implementation: POST requires JSON body length 2..4096, bounded headers/line lengths, and a matching Origin if Origin is present. Missing Origin is accepted. Raw GNSS listener packets retain sequence, receipt time, length, truncation and overwrite counts; 32-packet ring, at most 20480 bytes per retained packet. Switches resolve exact SDK keys GPSSNRInfoPushEnable and CeInfoEnable, check canSet, then call UAVKeyManager.x through a single setter queue.
features.write_or_side_effect: Two actual device diagnostic SET candidates. Only an explicit disconnected Boolean blocks requests; unknown connection is not rejected. Worker reads previous value from SDK cache and marks ownership before ACK if previous is not true, including unknown.
features.confirmation: HTTP response is request_queued. Setter callbacks record ACK status and wait-for-data text; no independent switch GET/readback verifies the requested value.
features.restore_lifecycle: end invalidates generations, clears work/data/listeners and queues false for switches marked owned; it does not restore an unknown/previous value. Cleanup workers lack a connection-identity/generation check at dispatch. The HTTP server remains available until close. This is a potential cross-session cleanup issue, not an observed device event.
features.reuse: Rebuild protocol and typed record format, adding authentication even on loopback, exact session binding, a fresh baseline, result correlation and restoration. Do not expose these switches as passive observation.

features.title: Fly 共存保护是启动时的 root ADB 操作
entry: Manifest provider flycoexist.InitProvider.onCreate runs on process/provider initialization, before the activity-level Startup checks.
The installer-owned fly-coexist.enabled marker is the enabling condition; no marker means immediate return.

defaults.enabled: off when no marker; installer coexist choice can create marker

implementation: InitProvider creates a daemon FutureTask, waits up to 4.5s, and calls root().
root() first checks id -u; if needed, it sets ro.boot.dbg_cnt only when empty, requests ADB TCP port5555 and adbd restart, then polls UID0.

write_or_side_effect: ProcessBuilder getprop/setprop in app identity; TCP 127.0.0.1:5555; ADB shell am force-stop.

restore_lifecycle: Marker survives launches until removed by installer mode changes or app data removal.
This provider has no baseline/restore of prior running apps, ADB properties or root state. Stopped apps may later be launched normally.
features.reuse: Clarifies the process-conflict prerequisite and why a supposedly ordinary app launch may touch ADB or fail before UI appears.

features.title: 诊断日志默认不加密；开关覆盖七个原类调用点
entry: Current Menu advanced diagnostics flightSwitch(enc) -> S.setEncLogs; original crypto wrappers call S.encLogs at entry.

defaults.in_process_cache: sEnc initially-1; setter updates both cache and preference

implementation: Seven hooks across five classes: uav.log.impl.SimpleEncryption.encrypt(String), uav.midware.sdr.log.CommonLogEncryption.encrypt(String/byte[]), lct.log.impl.SimpleEncryption.encrypt(String), lcti.log.impl.SimpleEncryption.encrypt/decrypt(String), uav.core.log.crypto.LogCrypto.a(String).

FlightRecord decryption and SandPlain native logging are separate features.

No network/API call exists in this logger class.

It records cache observations rather than verified device GET replies or RF evidence.
restore_lifecycle: Log files survive process restart and are rotated; no UI erase/stop switch in Probe. Encryption toggle does not wrap these direct writes.

Reflection must resolve RxCSDK.P(UAVKeyInfo) and18 selected flight-controller key fields.

entry: Manifest non-exported apptelemetry.InitProvider.onCreate calls LaunchTelemetry.start.

Current Menu.page(0) adds apptelemetry.Entry, whose switch calls setEnabled.

A true accepted response updates persistent success state. The endpoint is https://redfly.app/api/app/v1/.

No endpoint was accessed by this analysis.

features.reuse: Identifies the mod author service, exact data contract and actual automatic trigger; avoids mistaking a webpage privacy sentence for the implementation.

The no-coordinate/no-serial finding is limited to this launch-diagnostics payload, not every DJI/app networking component.

features.title: 诊断限频、退出和加密边界是客户端逻辑
entry: TelemetryPolicy is loaded/persisted by the main-process worker; foreground/network events schedule ticks.
setEnabled(false) updates preference, requests active-connection disconnect and schedules pending-state cancellation.
implementation: Retries reuse a pending event payload; response caps are4096 bytes and payload is capped at2048 bytes.
HTTP429/503 can extend Retry-After; most other3xx/4xx except408/409 stop that event.
Fallback decompilation confirms retry scheduling uses nextAttempt while unfinished with attempts<4; completed/exhausted events use max(newEventAt,nextAttempt).
The challenge uses SHA-256 work and Base64URL encoding; neither is payload encryption. This module uses HTTPS and does not install a custom TrustManager/HostnameVerifier or field-level encryption.
write_or_side_effect: Up to4 event attempts can involve separate challenge and launch HTTP requests; this is not a cap of4 total HTTP requests.
On pause/stop only lifecycle counters are changed. An already-started HTTP operation may finish; disabling also asks for disconnect but is not a proof that prior bytes were unsent.
confirmation: At most one client-acknowledged successful event per24h is enforced from retained state.
HTTP transport protection is TLS subject to the app/platform TLS configuration; no end-to-end or at-rest encryption is established.
restore_lifecycle: Toggleoff clears pending payload/state.finished and prevents future allowed attempts; toggleon can schedule again while honoring retained time limits.
Persistent ID, successful timestamps and remote data are not rolled back by the switch.
features.reuse: Provides a reusable conceptual separation between local scheduling state, in-flight cancellation and server acknowledgement.

product_and_permission_conditions: Foreground/idle/current-network conditions are rechecked before a POST write and during proof work.
Clock state and a writer file lock protect local rate bookkeeping; unavailable/corrupt local state blocks the feature for the process.
details.independent_rewrite_needed: If reimplemented, make diagnostics opt-in, test cancellation/duplicate semantics independently and document which state persists; never conflate Base64/hash with encryption.
does_not_establish: No network timing, retry, TLS interception or server de-duplication behavior was tested.
The rate policy does not prove the server received only one copy when acknowledgements are lost.

features.title: UTMiSS opt-out 是隐私授权与应用上传服务的门禁
entry: Existing privacy settings VM.setUtmissReportEnableState writes PrivacyType.UTMISS_REPORT through IPrivacyService.p4.

confirmation: Confirms a real application-side opt-out gate and lifecycle stop operation, separate from the RedFly launch-diagnostics feature.
restore_lifecycle: The privacy setting persists through its privacy service; re-enabling permits a later eligible start.
No native-quiescence, persisted aircraft change or baseline/restore proof follows from stop returning.

features.title: SandPlain：原生 _sand 日志保留记录头、正文为明文
features.entry: Java UAVSDKManager initialization -> JNISdk native_initialize -> JNI_SDKInitialize -> uav::sdk::initialize -> ModuleMediator::InitializeLog -> uav::base::InitializeUAVLog -> Logger::Initialize
features.defaults: Fixed code path in the supplied native library; no corresponding per-record Java enc_logs preference test is present in the inspected formatter/writer
features.implementation: libsdk_base.so Logger::BuildFileName builds a dated _sand filename with a counter and .log suffix. The function still named plog::EncryptFormatter::format invokes TxtFormatter::format, zero-initializes a buffer, adds an 8-byte record header including magic/length, and copies the text unchanged. UavLogAppender::write queues that formatted buffer; its worker directly writes the buffer to the file descriptor. The inspected normal data path contains no encryption operation.
features.write_or_side_effect: App diagnostic log file output; no aircraft state write or firmware decryption
features.confirmation: Native pseudocode, instruction body and direct-call/PLT bindings were inspected offline. No APK execution or generated _sand file was observed, and no claim is made that every app/native log family is plaintext.
features.restore_lifecycle: InitializeUAVLog uses a mutex and once-initialized flag. Re-enabling Java enc_logs cannot be assumed to restore encryption of this independent native path; a different native build would be required unless an uninspected external logger selection changes the route.
features.reuse: Useful for a bounded local diagnostic collector/parser and identifying log owner/format. It neither decrypts historical encrypted _sand records nor unlocks DAT/firmware. Adopt our own source-built logger and data redaction, not the vendor formatter implementation.
evidence: full-review/system/sdk-init-chain.json: direct ARM calls/tail branches and exact veneers/PLT bindings from JNI initialization

limitations: The ELF symbol range includes trailing data/literal pools; it is not identical to the Ghidra analyzed instruction body.
Ghidra loaded addresses include a 0x10000 base; ELF VA and file offsets are separately recorded.
Ghidra reports a no-return length-error call terminating the formatter body; conclusions concern the normal formatting path.
No matching ARMv7 official baseline was supplied, so patch authorship or exact byte-level change is not established.

features.title: Enhanced Transmission 的地区与展示判断有三处固定允许
entry: Existing LTE service/UI callers use LteService.Z0() for aircraft display eligibility, w2() for controller display eligibility, and q3() for feature-country eligibility.

FlightOSDTopSignalWithPopViewModel.z1 calls ILteService.Z0; DeviceListDetailViewModel.getAccessoriesVisibilityObservable combines Z0/w2 with actual aircraft/controller connection and selected aircraft serial matching.

defaults.effective_default: Hardcoded return at method entry; no preference or user switch surrounds these returns.
defaults.separate_visibility_force: h2 starts false; X4 can set it, but the 32-DEX direct-reference scan found no incoming X4 call. force_show_lte_switch_boolean is read with false default and developer-state condition; no writer was found in that scan.

implementation: Raw DEX confirms Z0/w2/q3 each begin an unconditional true return. The retained code after the return is unreachable.
Unreachable Z0/w2 code inspects DongleBaseInfo.isSupportDisplayControl and DEFAULT_SUPPORT_DISPLAY, otherwise falls back to q3.

Unreachable q3 code reads Y1==TRUE. Y1 is otherwise populated from the local unsupported-country list in M2 and cloud lte_feature_not_support_country_code in E5. The parallel binding-country subject Z1 remains separate.
This closes a regional/display implementation distinct from the mod-specific Auto LTE HYBRID attempt (radio-003) and APN shortcut/editor guards (radio-004).
write_or_side_effect: The forced methods only return booleans. Existing regional cloud configuration retrieval is still present; no request was made during this analysis.
confirmation: Static result: the service answers allowed/displayable regardless of the retained checks in these three methods. UI service absence, connection conditions and further checks can still suppress or reject an operation.
restore_lifecycle: The return values are embedded in this APK; they do not write a device region, firmware, SIM or subscription state.
No runtime restore switch for these forced bodies was identified. Selecting SDR turns off the requested link mode but does not restore the replaced region/display decisions.
features.reuse: Useful for distinguishing app presentation policy, app eligibility and actual radio/device state when designing diagnostics.

product_and_permission_conditions: These five-entry-point patch findings do not imply that all LTE UI is universally visible. The settings switch visibility still uses t4/x2: aircraft-dongle connection OR the separate force flag combined with IAppStateService.x().
No root, adb or shell call occurs in these boolean bodies. Hardware connection and downstream product/firmware/service checks remain outside them.
details.independent_rewrite_needed: Keep UI visibility, applicability and device-confirmed state separate; reproduce diagnostic observations independently rather than treating these constants as proof of compatibility.
does_not_establish: No matching official APK baseline was supplied, so surrounding DJI UI/service logic is not attributed wholesale to this mod.
Does not prove current RC2/Mini5Pro hardware, service entitlement, network access, or an operational LTE session.
Does not remove every country-related condition; k5 still reaches g3, which can reject Wi-Fi use in JP/RU/IL/UA/KZ with reason 22.

features.title: LTE 启用流程跳过两项地区拒绝，保留其余条件并实际提交 HYBRID
entry: A user change of the Enhanced Transmission switch enters SettingLinkModeLteViewGate.M; enabling calls Q, which consults ILteService.k5().
LteService.k5 first checks e3() for aircraft-area rejection (reason 32), then Z2() for controller-area rejection (reason 33). Both bodies are forced false in this artifact.

defaults.bypass_default: Always active in the current method bodies, independent of the Auto LTE preference.
defaults.link_mode_default: Not established as HYBRID by these changes. The view observes current GroundWLMLiveService.mode and derives checked state from LteService.f2().
defaults.last_enabled_preference: KEY_LTE_LAST_TIME_ENABLE_STATE is written by i5 after the mode-request success callback; it is not a region-bypass toggle.

implementation: Raw DEX confirms e3 and Z2 each begin an unconditional false return. This makes k5 reasons 32/33 unreachable through those branches.

The retained unreachable implementations test aircraft/controller dongle AREA_NOT_SUPPORT, cloud feature-country status and an eSIM-specific country condition. Normal JADX failed on these altered control-flow bodies; fallback output and raw instructions agree.

After the remaining k5 checks succeed and binding information is available, the view sends HYBRID via FlyModel.getGroundAirlink().getGroundWLM().getGroundWLMLiveService().getMode().j(mode). The off path requests SDR.

The request has success/error callbacks; success writes the last-enabled preference and logs success. The callback does not itself inspect FlyResult fields. Separately, X() observes the live mode and the gate updates the switch from current LteService.f2().
write_or_side_effect: Issues a FlyModel link-mode request rather than merely showing a switch or writing a preference. No request was executed by this review.
Existing binding, privacy and service checks may require network responses; their outcomes were not tested.
confirmation: Static closure of the advertised forced LTE activation at the app-region rejection boundary, plus a real HYBRID setter path. This is narrower than guaranteed cellular connectivity.
The mode observer is an app-visible confirmation route, but no live readback, network traffic or aircraft acceptance was collected.
restore_lifecycle: The ordinary off path requests SDR and, on its success callback, stores last-enabled=false. It refuses to close LTE while SDR is lost, and can show a weak-SDR confirmation dialog.
The region rejection bypass remains embedded after switching SDR. No device-region backup/rollback or restore for these method changes is present in the inspected path.
features.reuse: Provides a concrete distinction between removing an app-side rejection, submitting a device mode command, and confirming actual link operation.

product_and_permission_conditions: k5 continues through UAVFlycUtil.l/UAVRcUtil.k firmware/product eligibility, an aircraft dongle with nonempty serial, F1/G1 SIM/dongle checks, local-data-mode/network state, service-expiry/wait state, device-privacy authorization, binding info, camera/recording/upgrade constraints and the residual Wi-Fi area check.
F4/l5 remain conditional on server/binding-country state. This is not a subscription, hardware or server-authorization bypass.
The mode operation uses the app FlyModel service. These Java entry points do not use root/adb; downstream device acceptance was not exercised.
details.independent_rewrite_needed: An independent implementation would need explicit applicability checks, command outcome handling and live link validation; the preference write alone is not operational confirmation.
does_not_establish: Does not imply unrestricted LTE activation on every country/product or remove the remaining checks.
Does not prove a firmware patch, carrier/SIM activation, paid-service bypass, successful current Mini5Pro LTE session or device-side persistence.
No matched official baseline; the forced entry instructions are directly established, while surrounding service code may be inherited.

features.title: Developer Mode Tools 菜单可达，显示两类不同来源的 UUID，并有复制和手动扫码上报
entry: UAVSettingsFragment.initView binds account_center_settings_developer_mode_tools_layout, associates it with a supplier for DeveloperModeToolsFragment, and initListeners installs the click handler; handleLeftDrawableLayouts/showFragment replaces the child fragment.

initListeners subscribes to IAppStateService.U4 (developerModeSwitchObservable). Its lambda29 discards the incoming boolean and executes an unconditional true branch that sets this tools menu visible.

defaults.menu: Visible after the developer-mode observable emits, regardless of its boolean value; this is the Tools menu, separate from UAVDeveloperSettingsFragment.
defaults.phone_uuid: DefaultAppStateService.y reads key_uuid with empty fallback; init generates UUID.randomUUID().toString only if empty and persists it.
defaults.aircraft_fcuid: UAVProductKey.G / KeyProductUUID; empty default hides the FCUID row, nonempty values show it.
defaults.upload: Triggered by a manual scan result accepted by the configured suffix check; opening the page only displays values and registers handlers.

implementation: Phone text reads IAppStateService.y directly. DefaultAppStateService stores key_uuid through PersistenceStorage; this value is separate from the account-related synthetic FCUUIDSetting examined in system-009.

Aircraft text uses RxCSDK.h1(KeyProductUUID,empty). The chain reaches RxCSDK__RxCSDKKt.W, which reads Request.GetValue through RxCSDK.O/N, installs Request.Listen, and publishes the current/new value. This fragment does not issue Request.Get to force a new hardware transaction.
The two copy buttons read their displayed text and call ClipboardManager.setPrimaryClip(ClipData.newPlainText). No UUID editor or aircraft UUID write was found in this fragment.

The Scan button requests QR_CODE scanning. Its result parses URI authority and checks case-sensitive endsWith against .dbeta.me, .djicorp.com and .djigate.com from DJIApplicationConfigs.v; fallback confirms a matching suffix reaches the accepted branch.

An accepted scan result calls postScanUrl with the scanned URL. JSON fields are drone from IDeviceBaseService.D4(), mbrand from Build.BRAND, mmodel from Build.MODEL and sn from IDeviceBaseService.d1(). Headers include X-Device-Id from the app Phone UUID, request ID, app/version/platform metadata and Android release. The oddly named code_uuid header also receives Android release, not the displayed FCUID.
The request callback parses the response model and reports completion/error to the UI. No actual endpoint response or identifier values were accessed in this analysis.
write_or_side_effect: Manual clipboard writes for either displayed value.
Manual accepted QR scan sends an HTTP request to its scanned URL; there is no single hardcoded submission URL in the fragment and no automatic submission merely from opening this page.
confirmation: The website claim about displaying Phone UUID/Aircraft FCUID has a reachable implementation. It also exposes copy and QR-assisted diagnostic reporting actions.
The two UI labels refer to different identity sources: locally generated app state versus SDK product identity. Neither should be conflated with broadcast Remote ID or an operator/UAS identifier.
restore_lifecycle: Phone UUID persists in the app storage and is reused until absent; no reset control was identified here.
The aircraft display/listener and clipboard action do not write the SDK product UUID. The subscriptions are registered in the fragment composite-disposable collection.
Clipboard contents and a completed remote submission are not rolled back by closing the page.
features.reuse: Useful read-only diagnostic UI pattern and identity taxonomy: app-install UUID, product UUID and account/operator identifiers must remain distinct.

product_and_permission_conditions: Phone UUID is app-generated persistent state, not a demonstrated Android hardware identifier. The page does not query ANDROID_ID or an IMEI.

Aircraft FCUID comes from the current SDK KeyProductUUID value and its listener. A populated current value is required to show the aircraft row; its identity and freshness on a particular aircraft were not tested.
The display/copy path contains no root, adb or system-setting write. QR scanning launches DevelopAppCaptureBarCodeActivity; the scan/network route depends on the app camera/network facilities.
details.independent_rewrite_needed: An independent tool should label each identifier by source and age and make any diagnostic export explicit; do not copy actual identifiers or embedded vendor constants into reports.
does_not_establish: No actual phone UUID, aircraft FCUID or serial was retrieved.
No live proof of menu rendering, SDK freshness, camera permission success, QR endpoint availability or server acceptance.
Without a matched official baseline, only the forced menu condition is directly identifiable as an altered body; the whole developer-tools implementation is not attributed to the mod.

distribution: Only independently written findings, names, hashes, locations and high-level paths. Vendor binaries/decompiled source/raw captures/credentials excluded. Private-analysis references denote excluded material; they are not public file links.
goal_boundary: Completes the agreed static functional inventory and reuse assessment only; no RID controller, real-device acceptance, RF closure or firmware decryption is claimed.
